_comment: Single place for everything that may change: the datastore link, the paper link, the site address. Edit, then run: python source/build.py

site.name: EvalSpec
site.tagline: A minimum reporting standard for LLM evaluation results

datastore._comment: The Hugging Face dataset that holds every record. When the dataset is renamed, change hf_repo only; every link and command on the site is derived from it.
datastore.name: EvalSpec

home._comment: The model and benchmark shown in the box at the top of the home page. When the datastore has no such pair, the pair with the most sources is shown.

paper.title: LLM Evaluation Discrepancies And How To Prevent Them
paper.venue_long: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027
paper._url_comment: arXiv or ACL Anthology address. While empty, the site shows the paper link as pending.
paper.cite_short: Psychias, et al., "LLM Evaluation Discrepancies And How To Prevent Them", Findings of EACL, 2027.
